environmentVariables.description: IMAP account username / email address.

server.name: io.github.AIWerk/mcp-server-vault
server.description: Bitwarden/Vaultwarden for agents: list tagged items, TOTP codes, one-time Sends, save new secrets.

environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden region or self-hosted mode (e.g. us, eu, or self-hosted).
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Base URL for self-hosted Vaultwarden, scheme+host only (e.g. https://pass.example.com). Omit for Bitwarden cloud.
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden API client_id (personal API key).
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden API client_secret (personal API key).
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Vault master password, used to unlock and decrypt items.
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MASTER_PASSWORD
